key_concepts: Forces always occur in action-reaction pairs
Action and reaction forces are equal in magnitude
Action and reaction forces act in opposite directions
Action and reaction forces act on two different objects
A single isolated force cannot exist
An object cannot exert a force without experiencing a reaction force
Action-reaction forces do not cancel because they act on different objects
The acceleration of an object depends on its mass for a given force
In interactions between unequal masses, the less massive object accelerates more
Free-body diagrams can identify and label action-reaction force pairs
